Write me a 3 paragraph story about a tiger who learns to cook biryani
8:20 PM

A young tiger named Raja lived in the Sundarbans and loved the smell of biryani drifting from nearby villages. One day, he befriended a kind chef who agreed to teach him. Raja practiced chopping onions with his claws, stirring rice gently, and layering spices just right.

After weeks of trying, Raja finally made his first pot of biryani. The aroma filled the forest, and animals gathered around. Even the chef came to taste it and declared it perfect.

From that day on, Raja became famous as the only tiger who could cook. He opened a small stall by the river, serving biryani to travelers and animals alike. His secret? A pinch of jungle herbs and a lot of heart. 🐅🍛
